info.io_fixed: Set your inputs and outputs, then start with confidence.
info.mount_note: Input and output locations must be valid to run analyses.
msg.io_inaccessible:
Cannot run because the input data folder or output folder is not accessible.
This UI can run analyses only when both the input location and output destination are valid.
Ask your setup owner to ensure the input/output folders are mounted when starting the UI.
msg.refs_missing:
Cannot run because reference files (refs) are not configured.
You need transcripts, genome, and GTF to proceed.
msg.engine_need_two_conditions:
Differential expression analysis (real) requires at least two conditions (e.g., Con vs STZ).
Only one condition is present, so it can't be saved as a differential expression analysis.
msg.run.locked:
Another run is using this output folder, or a previous run was interrupted.
Use a different output folder, or resume/recover the previous run.
msg.run.fastp_gzip:
Your input FASTQ is gzip-compressed (.gz), but the current preprocessing tried to read it as plain text.
Fix: run fastp (real) or make the stub preprocessing gzip-aware.
msg.run.fastp_missing:
Salmon can't start because fastp outputs are missing.
Run fastp first, or enable auto-cleanup.
msg.run.incomplete_files:
Some output files are incomplete, so the run cannot continue.
Re-generate or clear the incomplete marks before retrying.
msg.run_generic: An error occurred during execution. See details.
label.auto_recover: Automatically recover from incomplete outputs or stale locks (recommended)
